selection_rule: Bounded independent primary-source checks chosen for actual native yeast enzyme-assay methods, not agreement with a model. These are not silent replacements for the registered Hackett flux candidate.

sources.title: A model of yeast glycolysis based on a consistent kinetic characterisation of all its enzymes

verified_accessible_files.schema_limit: A PDF supplement was verified, but no row/cell-addressable raw initial-rate or absorbance-timecourse table was established. The associated BioModels model is not a measurement source.

assay_metadata.preparation: Yeast-expressed tagged enzymes from MORF/GST/TAP collections; purified enzyme amount/concentration assessed with BCA and preparation quality assessed with electrophoresis/Bioanalyzer.
assay_metadata.biological_amount_vs_activity: Measured preparation protein amount is not a measured active fraction. Tag placement, complexes and purification state must be matched explicitly.
assay_metadata.culture_for_omics: Y23925, a heterozygous deletion derivative of diploid BY4743; turbidostat-like continuous cultures without nutrient limitation at maximal growth. This is not the Hackett FY chemostat context.
assay_metadata.readout: NADH/NADPH formation or consumption at 340 nm; coupled where necessary; initial rates at varying substrate concentrations
assay_metadata.raw_readout_unit: Absorbance; exact deposited raw-readout columns/time units not recovered
assay_metadata.rate_conversion: Paper specifies an NAD(P)H extinction coefficient and coupling/background controls. Plate path length, enzyme preparation amount and raw timecourse/initial-rate source cells would need binding before a quantitative adapter.
assay_metadata.replicates: Methods say at least duplicate determinations at each substrate concentration. These are not documented independent biological preparations.

sources.potential_claim_scope: A newly preregistered assay-specific rate law conditional on substrate and measured total preparation amount could be considered if original initial-rate records and independent preparation IDs are recovered. No intrinsic active-enzyme kcat claim from fitted turnover parameters or unspecified active fractions.
blockers: No verified raw assay record table or source-cell mapping
Assay versus in-vivo strain/medium/tag context differs from Hackett
Independent biological support-group inventory not established
Exact frozen YeastGEM/GECKO/BRENDA/DLKcat ancestor overlap unresolved
sources.paper_hypothesis_policy: No reported regulatory conclusion or direction from this paper is used for feature selection. Any later paper-informed target choice must be labeled replication.

sources.title: Testing biochemistry revisited: how in vivo metabolism can be understood from in vitro enzyme kinetics

primary_article.license: Creative Commons Attribution; the exact license version was not verified

public_archive.reason: Mixed experimental summaries, kinetic parameter tables and simulated/model-derived results; no full archive handoff.

verified_candidate_files.measurement_status: Mixed kinetic-parameter/assay-summary candidate; the caption alone does not make fitted parameters raw initial-rate observations.

verified_candidate_files.measurement_status: Assay-protocol metadata candidate; not response labels.

assay_metadata.strain: CEN.PK113-7D; MATa MAL2-8c SUC2; haploid prototroph
assay_metadata.culture: Aerobic glucose-limited chemostats in defined mineral medium; dilution settings 0.1 and 0.35 per hour; paired nonstarved and nitrogen-starvation contexts described by the source.
assay_metadata.not_matched_to_hackett: Different strain background and growth/starvation protocol; not interchangeable independent support for the registered FY-culture flux response.
assay_metadata.extract_preparation: Fresh cell-free extracts prepared with FastPrep; not purified single-enzyme material
assay_metadata.readout: NAD(P)H-linked Vmax assays with standardized in-vivo-like assay medium
assay_metadata.activity_amount_denominator: Exact table-reported activity denominator and uncertainty/replicate mapping remain unverified; never substitute absolute enzyme amount for crude-extract protein.
assay_metadata.transport_measurement: Separate 14C-glucose zero-trans influx measured in a five-second uptake assay at 30 C; source subsequently fits Michaelis-Menten equations. Fitted transport parameters are not raw uptake observations.

explicitly_excluded_source_classes: Supplemental predictions compared with experiments unless an independently verified strict measurement projection is available
sources.potential_claim_scope: At most a new, explicitly scoped extract-level activity or measured transport response study after raw records, units and whole-biological-experiment identities are recovered; not an intrinsic Cdc19 kcat or an already matched Hackett validation.

custody_decision.next_authorized_step: Parent/verifier may pursue original raw assay/preparation records or a new scientifically appropriate protocol. Freeze any new experiment inventory and feature-selection declaration before quantitative export; do not relax the current protocol post hoc.
